capabilities.item6: Turns conversations into leads — captures the contact and what they need, ready for your team or your CRM.
capabilities.item7: A summary every Monday — what happened, what was asked most, what needs your attention.

hero.title: Intelligent search in Moldova and Romania's case law
hero.sub: Over 275,000 court decisions in one place — CSJ, Constitutional Court, ECHR, and Romania's High Court of Cassation. Search by keywords or simply describe your situation in your own words, and the AI finds the right cases in seconds.

about.label: CONCEPT
about.title: Four courts, one search bar
about.text1: Precedentia brings the case law of Moldova and Romania together in one place — four courts, one simple search bar. What used to take hours of digging through archives now takes seconds.
about.text2: Search by keywords or describe your situation in your own words — the platform understands what you mean, not just what you type. The AI assistant answers legal questions with exact quotes from real decisions, and you can even attach a ruling to instantly find similar precedents.
about.text3: All databases are automatically updated from official sources, ensuring practitioners always have access to the latest decisions.

keyword.text: Type a few words and get matching decisions instantly, from all four courts at once.
